book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: Dijan preya blanga God blanga panishim ola nogudwan pipul

content.text: Ol yumob boswan, yumob reken yumob kotim pipul raitwei?
Yumob reken yumob gibit ebribodi feyago? Najing!
Yumob oni jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbala ting,
en kilimbat pipul ebriweya langa dijan kantri.
Nogudwan pipul oldei dum nogudbala ting olataim.
Brom det taim wen deibin bon, dei oldei dalimbat laiya.
Olabat jidan wulijim sneik garram detmatj nogudwan poisin.
Olabat jadimap miselp irriwol jis laik det defwan kobra sneik.
Im nomo lisin det myusik wen det men plei,
o det klebawan men wen im singimbat.
God, dislot pipul wulijim detlot jigiwan laiyan.
Breigimap ola tuth blanga olabat.
Larram olabat jis binijap wulijim woda weya im draiyap.
Larram olabat jidan wulijim fletwan gras weya fladwoda nokamdan.
Larram olabat binijap wulijim det wem weya im draiyap.
Larram olabat jidan wulijim beibi wen im bon dedwan.
God, dumaji yu wail langa olabat, wal yu binijimap olabat bifo dei sabi,
jis laik weya sambodi kadimdan rabishwan gras.
Ola pipul hu jidan trubalawei garra jidan gudbinji wen dei luk ola nogudbala pipul git panish.
Olabat garra luk detmatj blad buldan blanga detlot nogudbala pipul.
Ola pipul garra tok, “Trubala orait. Gudbala ting garra kaman langa detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei.
Trubala God im jidan boswan en im gibit feyago langa ebri kantri.”
